subject: Spring 2027 Graduate Student Travel Grant applications are open
body:
Dear {{firstName}},
The Office of Graduate Studies is pleased to announce that applications for the Spring 2027 Graduate Student Travel Grant are now open. These grants help offset the cost of presenting research at academic conferences.
Key details:
  • Awards of up to $750 per student, per academic year
  • Open to currently enrolled degree-seeking graduate students
  • You must be presenting (not just attending) at the conference
  • Application deadline: December 12, 2026
Applications are submitted through your MyUSF student portal under the Graduate Studies tab. Please allow four to six weeks for review.
Questions may be directed to the Office of Graduate Studies at (813) 974-1234.
Sincerely,
USF Office of Graduate Studies
